# Atlas AI

> The AI workforce for North African commerce — trilingual AI employees (Arabic, French, English) that sell, support, and grow your store 24/7 across WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Telegram.

Atlas AI helps shops in Algeria, Tunisia and Morocco run conversational commerce without hiring a bigger team. AI employees answer customers, recommend products from your catalog, take orders, and hand off to humans when needed. Built for local channels, currencies and payment rails (CIB, BaridiMob, Flouci, CMI, COD).
